metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Trust Boundary Audit Checklist (Stage 1)
metadata.description: High-fidelity audit checklist for trust boundary edge properties. These are the most critical security properties covering edges where data crosses trust domains.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP: User wrap amount validation at LiquidityManager entry
checklist.description: Verify that the LiquidityManager correctly validates all user-provided wrap amounts at the trust boundary. This check ensures untrusted user input cannot bypass validation to corrupt protocol state.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the LiquidityManager contract's wrap() function entry point
2. Trace the data flow from external call to internal state modification
3. Verify that amount parameter is validated before any state changes occur
4. Confirm BN254 field constraint (amount <= 2^248-1) is enforced via zERC20._afterTokenTransfer
5. Verify user balance is checked via ERC20.transferFrom before proceeding
6. Check for potential integer overflow in amount calculations
7. Verify no code paths allow wrap with zero amount or maximum uint256

executable_checks.assertion: No high/medium findings on wrap() function

executable_checks.command: Review wrap() function for require/revert statements at entry

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-001-USER-INITIATES-WRAP → Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-001-USER-INITIATES-WRAP to hold true in the code. User-to-LiquidityManager is an UNTRUSTED→IN_SCOPE boundary.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP correctly validates wrap request data before processing
checklist.description: Verify that the LiquidityManager state transition to processing wrap correctly validates the DATA-WRAP-REQUEST structure.
detection_procedure: 1. Identify the state machine for wrap operations in LiquidityManager
2. Verify wrap cannot proceed without valid underlying token balance
3. Confirm atomic state transitions (no partial wrap states)
4. Check for reentrancy guards on wrap entry point
5. Verify wrap cannot be called on paused contract if pausable

executable_checks.assertion: State transitions are atomic and validated

executable_checks.command: Trace wrap() execution path for state consistency
executable_checks.assertion: No intermediate states allow partial wrap completion

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-001-USER-INITIATES-WRAP → Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP. This check verifies the wrap state machine correctly enforces the boundary property.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP: User unwrap amount validation at LiquidityManager entry
checklist.description: Verify that the LiquidityManager correctly validates all user-provided unwrap amounts at the trust boundary, ensuring users cannot unwrap more zERC20 than they hold.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the LiquidityManager contract's unwrap() function entry point
2. Verify that zERC20 balance check occurs before state modification
3. Confirm burn operation will revert on insufficient balance
4. Verify underlying liquidity check prevents unwrap when pool is empty
5. Check fee calculation uses ceiling division to protect protocol
6. Verify amount - fee calculation cannot underflow

executable_checks.assertion: No high/medium findings on unwrap() function

executable_checks.command: Review unwrap() for balance checks before burn
executable_checks.assertion: ERC20 balance validation before any state change

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-007-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP → Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-007-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP to hold true in the code. User-to-LiquidityManager is an UNTRUSTED→IN_SCOPE boundary.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE correctly uses ceiling rounding to protect protocol from fee undercollection
checklist.description: Verify that IncentiveLib.computeIncentive uses ceiling division for fee calculation, ensuring the protocol never undercollects fees.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib.computeIncentive function
2. Verify ceiling division is used for fee calculation (not floor)
3. Check for edge cases: fee on very small amounts, fee on maximum amounts
4. Verify fee bounds are within reasonable range [0, amount]
5. Test with fuzzing for rounding correctness
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-007-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP → Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE. This check verifies fee calculation supports the unwrap boundary security.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER: BN254 field constraint enforcement on zERC20 transfers
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20 transfer correctly validates value <= 2^248-1 at the trust boundary, ensuring ZK circuit compatibility is maintained.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate zERC20._afterTokenTransfer hook
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant is correctly set to 2^248-1
3. Confirm check applies to recipient balance post-transfer, not just transfer amount
4. Verify check applies to mint, burn, and transfer operations
5. Check that ValueTooLarge error is properly defined and reverted
6. Test edge cases: transfer to address with balance near MAX_VALUE

executable_checks.command: Verify _afterTokenTransfer checks recipient balance, not just amount

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-014-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER → Edge EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-014-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER to hold true in the code. CRITICAL: BN254 field constraint is essential for ZK circuit soundness. User-to-zERC20 is an UNTRUSTED→IN_SCOPE boundary.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN correctly appends transfer data using SHA-256 with 248-bit truncation
checklist.description: Verify the hash chain update mechanism correctly commits to (to, value) using SHA-256 truncated to 248 bits for ZK compatibility.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate hash chain update logic in zERC20
2. Verify SHA-256 is used (not keccak256)
3. Confirm truncation to 248 bits matches ZK circuit expectations
4. Verify hash chain is updated for every transfer, mint, burn
5. Check hash chain ordering is deterministic
6. Verify no race conditions in concurrent transfers

executable_checks.assertion: Hash chain updated correctly on each transfer

executable_checks.command: Compare on-chain hash computation with ZK circuit hash
executable_checks.assertion: Hash functions are identical in both implementations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-014-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER → Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN. This check verifies hash chain integrity supports the transfer boundary security.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT: Groth16 proof validation before minting
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that the Verifier contract correctly validates Groth16 ZKP proofs at the trust boundary before any token minting occurs. This is the most critical security boundary.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Verifier.teleport() function
2. Verify Groth16 proof verification is called BEFORE any state modification
3. Confirm verifyOpaqueNovaProof or equivalent is invoked with correct public inputs
4. Verify public inputs include: transfer root reference, recipient hash, amount
5. Check that proof verification reverts on invalid proof
6. Verify no code path bypasses proof verification
7. Confirm proof cannot be reused (monotonicity check)
8. Test with malformed proof data (wrong curve points, invalid field elements)

executable_checks.command: Verify proof verification order precedes state changes

executable_checks.assertion: No high findings on teleport path

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-021-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT → Edge EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-021-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT to hold true in the code. CRITICAL BOUNDARY: User-to-Verifier is an UNTRUSTED→IN_SCOPE boundary. ZKP soundness is the foundation of protocol security.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces strictly increasing totalTeleported to prevent double-spend
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that totalTeleported[recipient] is strictly monotonically increasing, preventing any teleport replay or double-spend attacks.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate totalTeleported mapping in Verifier contract
2. Verify check: newTotalTeleported > totalTeleported[recipient]
3. Confirm check uses strict inequality (>), not (>=)
4. Verify totalTeleported is updated AFTER minting, not before
5. Check for overflow protection on totalTeleported
6. Verify no admin function can reset or decrease totalTeleported
7. Test replay attack scenarios with same proof

executable_checks.assertion: Replay attempts revert with non-monotonic error

executable_checks.command: Verify no setter for totalTeleported except via teleport
executable_checks.assertion: totalTeleported only modified in teleport path

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-021-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT → Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. This check verifies the double-spend prevention mechanism at the teleport boundary. CRITICAL: This is the primary anti-replay mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE checks root exists in proved or global roots
checklist.description: Verify that teleport operations validate the referenced transfer root exists in either provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate root reference validation in teleport function
2. Verify root is checked against provedTransferRoots mapping
3. Verify root is checked against globalTransferRoots mapping
4. Confirm RootNotFound error is reverted for invalid roots
5. Check that root validation cannot be bypassed by any code path
6. Verify roots cannot be removed or invalidated after proof

executable_checks.command: Verify root lookup in both local and global mappings
executable_checks.assertion: Root must exist in provedTransferRoots OR globalTransferRoots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-021-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT → Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE. This check verifies root reference validation at the teleport boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB: Source EID validation before processing LayerZero messages
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that the Hub contract validates source endpoint ID (EID) against registered Verifier list before accepting any cross-chain message payload.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub._lzReceive() callback implementation
2. Verify source EID is extracted from Origin struct
3. Confirm EID is validated against registered peer/verifier list
4. Verify validation occurs BEFORE payload decoding or processing
5. Check that unauthorized EIDs cause revert, not silent ignore
6. Verify peer list cannot be modified by non-owner
7. Test with spoofed source EID from unregistered chain

executable_checks.assertion: Messages from unregistered EIDs are rejected
EID validation before ANY payload processing

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-023-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB → Edge EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-023-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB to hold true in the code. CRITICAL BOUNDARY: LayerZero-to-Hub is SEMI_TRUSTED→IN_SCOPE. Cross-chain message authentication is essential.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT stores root in correct token index slot
checklist.description: Verify that received transfer roots are stored in the correct slot based on source EID to token index mapping.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate root storage logic in Hub._lzReceive
2. Verify token index is correctly derived from source EID
3. Confirm root is stored in transferRoots[tokenIndex]
4. Check for potential index collision between different tokens
5. Verify storage slot boundaries (<=64 tokens for height-6 tree)

executable_checks.assertion: Roots stored in correct token slots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-023-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB → Node ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT. This check verifies root storage integrity after LayerZero message processing.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER: Hub EID validation before storing global root
checklist.description: RECOMMENDED: Verify that the Verifier contract validates source EID equals the authorized Hub before storing any global transfer root. Note: setPeer configuration already validates sender at LayerZero level, so explicit EID validation is defense-in-depth.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Verifier._lzReceive() callback implementation
2. Verify setPeer is configured correctly to restrict senders
3. Optionally verify source EID is compared against hubEid (defense-in-depth)
4. Verify validation occurs BEFORE storing global root
5. Check that non-hub EIDs cause revert or are rejected by setPeer
6. Verify hubEid is set correctly during deployment and cannot be changed
7. Test with spoofed message claiming to be from Hub

executable_checks.assertion: Messages from non-Hub EIDs are rejected (either by setPeer or explicit check)

executable_checks.command: Verify setPeer configuration or _lzReceive checks _origin.srcEid == hubEid
executable_checks.assertion: Only Hub EID can store global roots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-024-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER → Edge EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER. RECOMMENDED: Source EID validation is recommended but not strictly required since setPeer configuration already validates sender at LayerZero level. Explicit validation is defense-in-depth.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT correctly stores global root with aggregation sequence
checklist.description: Verify that globalTransferRoots mapping is correctly updated with the received root and aggregation sequence.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate global root storage in Verifier
2. Verify root is stored in globalTransferRoots[aggSeq]
3. Confirm aggSeq is correctly extracted from payload
4. Check for potential overwrite of existing roots
5. Verify event emission for tracking

executable_checks.assertion: Global roots stored with correct sequence

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-024-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER → Node ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT. This check verifies global root storage integrity.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO: Outbound message encoding and destination correctness
checklist.description: Verify that the Verifier correctly encodes and sends proved transfer roots to LayerZero with correct destination.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate root relay function in Verifier
2. Verify _lzSend is called with correct destination EID (Hub)
3. Confirm payload encoding matches Hub's expected format
4. Check that only proved roots are relayed (not arbitrary data)
5. Verify sufficient gas fee is forwarded
6. Check for potential manipulation of destination EID

executable_checks.assertion: Root relay uses correct encoding and destination
Consistent payload encoding between Verifier and Hub

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-025-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO → Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-025-VERIFIER-TO-LAYERZERO to hold true in the code. Verifier-to-LayerZero is IN_SCOPE→SEMI_TRUSTED boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO: Broadcast to all registered Verifiers without omission
checklist.description: Verify that the Hub broadcasts aggregation roots to ALL registered Verifiers without any omission.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub.broadcast() function
2. Verify iteration over complete verifier EID list
3. Confirm _lzSend is called for each registered verifier
4. Check that broadcast cannot partially succeed (atomic)
5. Verify no verifiers can be skipped due to gas limits
6. Check for potential DoS via malicious verifier registration

executable_checks.command: Verify broadcast loop iterates complete verifier list

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-026-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO → Edge EDGE-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-026-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO to hold true in the code. Hub-to-LayerZero is IN_SCOPE→SEMI_TRUSTED boundary.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION correctly computes PoseidonT3 Merkle tree
checklist.description: Verify that Hub aggregation correctly computes the PoseidonT3 Merkle tree over registered token roots.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate aggregation computation in Hub
2. Verify PoseidonT3 library is used with correct parameters
3. Confirm tree structure matches ZK circuit expectations (height-6)
4. Check handling of sparse tree (< 64 tokens)
5. Verify empty slots use zero padding correctly
6. Compare aggregation output with off-chain computation

executable_checks.command: Verify PoseidonT3 parameters match circom configuration
executable_checks.assertion: On-chain and ZK circuit use same Poseidon parameters

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-026-HUB-TO-LAYERZERO → Node ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION. This check verifies aggregation computation supports the broadcast boundary security.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE: minAmountOut slippage protection enforcement
checklist.description: Verify that the Adaptor enforces minAmountOut slippage protection when sending bridge requests to Stargate.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Adaptor bridge initiation function
2. Verify minAmountOut is passed to Stargate.send
3. Confirm minAmountOut is user-provided or calculated with safety margin
4. Check that zero minAmountOut is rejected
5. Verify slippage calculation accounts for bridge fees
6. Test extreme slippage scenarios

executable_checks.assertion: Slippage protection is enforced on bridge

executable_checks.command: Verify minAmountOut parameter in Stargate.send call

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-027-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE → Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-027-ADAPTOR-TO-STARGATE to hold true in the code. Adaptor-to-Stargate is IN_SCOPE→SEMI_TRUSTED boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-ADAPTOR: lzCompose callback authentication and slippage validation
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that lzCompose callback validates msg.sender is LayerZero endpoint and _from is registered zerc20 address. Must NOT revert on decode errors to prevent asset lock - emit event and return instead.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Adaptor.lzCompose() function
2. Verify msg.sender == endpoint validation
3. Confirm _from address is validated against registered zerc20 addresses
4. Verify amountReceivedLD is extracted from OFTReceipt
5. Confirm amountReceivedLD >= minAmountOut check
6. Verify refund handling if slippage exceeded
7. CRITICAL: Verify decode errors emit DecodeBridgeRequestFailed event and return (NOT revert) to prevent asset lock
8. Check for reentrancy protection on lzCompose (note: reentrancy is not a vulnerability unless concrete exploit exists)
9. Test with spoofed lzCompose from non-endpoint

executable_checks.assertion: Unknown zerc20 origins rejected with event, not revert
Decode errors emit event and return, NOT revert

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-028-LAYERZERO-TO-ADAPTOR → Edge EDGE-LAYERZERO-TO-ADAPTOR. CRITICAL BOUNDARY: LayerZero-to-Adaptor is SEMI_TRUSTED→IN_SCOPE callback. If LayerZero is TRUSTED, this may not strictly be a trust boundary but validation is recommended. Reentrancy note: even if reentrancy is possible, it is not a vulnerability unless a concrete exploit path exists.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-DECODE-COMPOSE-MSG correctly handles OFT compose message decoding errors
checklist.description: Verify that lzCompose correctly decodes the OFTComposeMessage structure and handles decode errors by emitting events (NOT reverting) to prevent asset lock.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate compose message decoding in lzCompose
2. Verify OFTComposeMessage structure matches LayerZero/Stargate spec
3. Confirm refund address is correctly extracted
4. Check for potential overflow/underflow in decoding
5. CRITICAL: Verify malformed messages emit DecodeBridgeRequestFailed event and return (NOT revert) to prevent assets from being stuck

executable_checks.assertion: Malformed messages emit event and return, do NOT revert

executable_checks.command: Compare OFTComposeMessage struct with LayerZero SDK

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-028-LAYERZERO-TO-ADAPTOR → Node ACTION-DECODE-COMPOSE-MSG. CRITICAL: lzCompose must NOT revert on decode errors to prevent assets from being stuck in the contract.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20: Minter authorization on mint/burn calls
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20 mint/burn functions correctly validate caller is the authorized minter (LiquidityManager).
detection_procedure: 1. Locate zERC20.mint() and zERC20.burn() functions
2. Verify onlyMinter modifier is applied
3. Confirm minter() returns LiquidityManager address
4. Verify minter cannot be changed except by owner
5. Check that direct mint/burn calls from EOA fail
6. Test authorization from different contracts
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-029-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20 → Edge EDGE-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-029-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20 to hold true in the code. LiquidityManager-to-zERC20 is IN_SCOPE→IN_SCOPE internal boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT: Verifier authorization on teleport minting
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that zERC20.teleport() correctly validates caller is the authorized verifier before minting tokens.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate zERC20.teleport() function
2. Verify onlyVerifier modifier or equivalent check
3. Confirm verifier() returns Verifier contract address
4. Verify verifier cannot be changed except by owner
5. Check that teleport validates proof was verified before call
6. Verify mint amount matches delta from totalTeleported
7. Test teleport from unauthorized addresses
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-030-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT → Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT. This check verifies the implementation of the critical trust boundary EDGE-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-030-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT to hold true in the code. CRITICAL BOUNDARY: This is the second privileged minting pathway. Verifier-to-zERC20 is IN_SCOPE→IN_SCOPE internal boundary with ZKP pre-validation.

checklist.title: Verify that the implementation of ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT correctly calculates mint amount as delta
checklist.description: Verify that Verifier.teleport correctly computes mint amount as newTotalTeleported - totalTeleported[recipient].
detection_procedure: 1. Locate teleport mint amount calculation in Verifier
2. Verify delta = newTotal - currentTotal formula
3. Confirm no underflow possible (newTotal > currentTotal enforced)
4. Verify delta is passed to zERC20.teleport
5. Check for potential overflow in totalTeleported update
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-030-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT → Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT. This check verifies mint amount calculation at the teleport boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OWNER-UPGRADE: Owner authorization on UUPS upgrade (OUT OF SCOPE)
checklist.description: NOTE: This boundary is OUT OF SCOPE per trust model. Owner compromise is not considered a vulnerability. This check documents the boundary for completeness.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify UUPS upgrade requires onlyOwner
2. Document that no timelock exists
3. Note: Owner compromise is OUT OF SCOPE
4. Recommend: Multisig + monitoring as compensating controls
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-031-OWNER-UPGRADE → Edge EDGE-OWNER-UPGRADE. OUT OF SCOPE: Owner operations are trusted per trust model. No timelock protection - immediate upgrade effect. Compensating controls: multisig, monitoring.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OWNER-SET-MINTER: Owner authorization on minter change (OUT OF SCOPE)
checklist.description: NOTE: This boundary is OUT OF SCOPE per trust model. Owner compromise is not considered a vulnerability. This check documents the boundary for completeness.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify setMinter requires onlyOwner
2. Document that no timelock exists
3. Note: Owner compromise is OUT OF SCOPE
4. CRITICAL: Compromised owner can grant unlimited minting
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-032-OWNER-SET-MINTER → Edge EDGE-OWNER-SET-MINTER. OUT OF SCOPE: Owner operations are trusted per trust model. CRITICAL IMPACT: No timelock means compromised owner can immediately grant unlimited minting authority.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OWNER-REGISTER-TOKEN: Owner authorization on token registration (OUT OF SCOPE)
checklist.description: NOTE: This boundary is OUT OF SCOPE per trust model. Owner compromise is not considered a vulnerability. This check documents the boundary for completeness.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify registerToken requires onlyOwner
2. Document registration workflow
3. Note: Owner compromise is OUT OF SCOPE
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-033-OWNER-REGISTER-TOKEN → Edge EDGE-OWNER-REGISTER-TOKEN. OUT OF SCOPE: Owner operations are trusted per trust model.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OWNER-SET-VERIFIERS: Owner authorization on verifier rotation (OUT OF SCOPE)
checklist.description: NOTE: This boundary is OUT OF SCOPE per trust model. Owner compromise is not considered a vulnerability. This check documents the boundary for completeness.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify verifier configuration requires onlyOwner
2. Document that no timelock exists
3. CRITICAL: Malicious verifier keys could accept forged proofs
4. Note: Owner compromise is OUT OF SCOPE
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-034-OWNER-SET-VERIFIERS → Edge EDGE-OWNER-SET-VERIFIERS. OUT OF SCOPE: Owner operations are trusted per trust model. CRITICAL IMPACT: No timelock means compromised owner can immediately set malicious verification keys.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OWNER-SET-FEE-PARAMS: Owner authorization on fee configuration (OUT OF SCOPE)
checklist.description: NOTE: This boundary is OUT OF SCOPE per trust model. Owner misconfiguration is INFORMATIONAL severity. This check documents the boundary for completeness.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify fee parameter update requires onlyOwner
2. Check if extreme values (0%, 100%) are possible
3. Document that misconfiguration is owner responsibility
4. Recommend: Fee bounds checks as defensive measure
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-035-OWNER-SET-FEE-PARAMS → Edge EDGE-OWNER-SET-FEE-PARAMS. OUT OF SCOPE: Owner operations are trusted per trust model. Misconfiguration is INFORMATIONAL severity.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER: Proof soundness guarantees validity at on-chain verification
checklist.description: Verify that proofs output by the Prover service are validated on-chain by Groth16 soundness, ensuring invalid proofs cannot be accepted.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify Prover outputs are always verified on-chain
2. Confirm no trusted prover assumption exists
3. Check Groth16 verifier implementation soundness
4. Verify public input extraction from proof
5. Test with malformed/invalid proofs from prover

executable_checks.command: Verify no bypass of on-chain verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-036-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER → Edge EDGE-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER. This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-036-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER to hold true in the code. Prover-to-User is UNTRUSTED→UNTRUSTED boundary - security guaranteed by ZKP soundness, not prover trust.

checklist.title: Verify that DATA-GROTH16-PROOF structure matches on-chain verifier expectations
checklist.description: Verify the Groth16 proof format from Prover matches the on-chain verifier's expected structure.
detection_procedure: 1. Compare Prover proof output format with Verifier input format
2. Verify curve point serialization matches (G1, G2 points)
3. Confirm field element encoding is consistent
4. Check endianness and byte ordering
5. Test proof round-trip: generate -> serialize -> deserialize -> verify

executable_checks.command: Compare Prover proof struct with Verifier proof struct
Run end-to-end proof generation and verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-036-PROVER-OUTPUT-TO-USER → Data DATA-GROTH16-PROOF. This check verifies proof format compatibility across the boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-INDEXER-OUTPUT-TO-USER: Merkle proof validity guaranteed by ZK circuit verification
checklist.description: Verify that Merkle proofs from the Indexer are cryptographically validated during ZK circuit execution, ensuring invalid proofs cause proof generation failure.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify Merkle proofs are inputs to ZK circuit
2. Confirm circuit validates Merkle path against root

This check verifies the implementation of the trust boundary EDGE-INDEXER-OUTPUT-TO-USER, which is essential for PROP-EDGE-037-INDEXER-OUTPUT-TO-USER to hold true in the code. Indexer-to-User is SEMI_TRUSTED→UNTRUSTED boundary - invalid proofs cause proof generation failure, not security breach.

checklist.title: Verify no unauthorized third minting pathway exists beyond LiquidityManager and Verifier
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that zERC20 tokens can ONLY be minted through the two authorized pathways: LiquidityManager.wrap() and Verifier.teleport(). No other minting pathway should exist.
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all functions that call _mint on zERC20
2. Verify only mint() and teleport() can create tokens
3. Confirm no inheritance-based bypass exists
4. Check for any proxy upgrade that could add minting
5. Verify constructor/initializer cannot mint arbitrary amounts
6. Search for any CREATE2-based bypass potential

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-029-LIQUIDITY-MANAGER-TO-ZERC20 + PROP-EDGE-030-VERIFIER-TO-ZERC20-TELEPORT → System SYSTEM-MINTING-AUTHORIZATION. CRITICAL SYSTEM CHECK: Both minting pathways (wrap/teleport) must be the ONLY ways to create zERC20 tokens.

checklist.title: Verify complete cross-chain message isolation via EID validation across all receiving contracts
checklist.description: CRITICAL: Verify that ALL contracts receiving LayerZero messages validate source EID, preventing any cross-chain message injection.
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all contracts implementing _lzReceive
2. Verify each has source EID validation at entry
3. Confirm no shared utility function bypasses validation
4. Check for any fallback or receive functions accepting messages
5. Test with spoofed EIDs from all registered chains
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-023-LAYERZERO-TO-HUB + PROP-EDGE-024-LAYERZERO-TO-VERIFIER → System SYSTEM-CROSS-CHAIN-BOUNDARIES. CRITICAL SYSTEM CHECK: Cross-chain security depends on complete EID validation coverage.
